# HerovaAi

> HerovaAi is an AI assistant for small businesses: it answers customer questions
> on WhatsApp in the owner's own words - their prices, their hours, their rules -
> and keeps a memory of the business. Customers need no new app.

## Pages
- [Project home](https://sahadat01832-del.github.io/): what HerovaAi is and where the app runs
- [HerovaAi product page](https://sahadat01832-del.github.io/herovaai/): what it does, who it is for, how to start
- [Automatic WhatsApp replies: what actually works](https://sahadat01832-del.github.io/herovaai/whatsapp-auto-reply/): a practical guide to automating customer replies
- [Connect your channels](https://sahadat01832-del.github.io/herovaai/connect/): step-by-step setup for WhatsApp, Facebook, Messenger, Instagram, YouTube and Google, including what cannot be automated
- [Frequently asked questions](https://sahadat01832-del.github.io/herovaai/faq/): short, factual answers
- [Privacy policy](https://sahadat01832-del.github.io/herovaai/privacy/)
- [Terms of service](https://sahadat01832-del.github.io/herovaai/terms/)

## Notes
- The app runs on the owner's own server; the live link is on the product page.
- The site is in English; the business serves customers in Bangladesh.
- No advertising or analytics trackers are used on any of these pages.
